### Web client: generated by the Node `npx meta gen`

The client tiers are generators in `metaobjects.config.ts`, whatever the backend: `formFile()`
from `@metaobjectsdev/codegen-ts-react`, `tanstackQuery()` and `tanstackGrid()` from
`@metaobjectsdev/codegen-ts-tanstack`, with the runtime packages `@metaobjectsdev/react` and
`@metaobjectsdev/tanstack`. Wrap the app in `<EntityFetcherProvider fetcher={...} baseUrl="/api">`:
`baseUrl` is where the server mounts its routes, and leaving it out drops that prefix from every
hook without an error. The `metaobjects-runtime-ui` skill has the detail.
